whyEpicare.subtitle: There are hundreds of agencies competing for your production. The difference isn't the carrier catalog — it's whether anyone actually built the system you work in every day.
whyEpicare.pillar1Desc: Est. 2021. Six thousand policyholders and a hundred active agents. You're joining something that already works, not a launch.
whyEpicare.pillar2Desc: GO AMS is ours. When something doesn't work, we change it — we don't file a ticket with a vendor and wait on their roadmap.
whyEpicare.pillar3Desc: Sign once, access the full portfolio. No negotiating contract by contract with each carrier.
whyEpicare.pillar4Desc: Contracting, commissions, and compliance with tickets, history, and SLAs. When something jams, there's someone by name fixing it.
